author: Dale Philip
description:
I tried this traditional Betawi food that's made from glutinous rice and duck or chicken egg and topped with serundeng (fried shredded coconut), dried shrimp, and fried shallots.

Despite it being a local food from this area of Indonesia it was very difficult to find, as was the case for many of the Betawi foods that I was looking to try.
title: Trying 'Kerak Telor' Betawi Omelette in Jakarta, Indonesia 🇮🇩
